title: Az alkotmányos rend és a jogállamiság (Constitutional Order & Rule of Law)
grammar: Constitutional Guarantees, Supranational Integration & Kin-State Registers in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain what the Fundamental Law, the separation of powers and the Constitutional Court are.
I can say that judges are independent and that the ombudsman protects fundamental rights.
I can read a short text about Hungary as a state governed by the rule of law.
I can use the words of this lesson about the Fundamental Law and the courts.
